review.review: The run ended with a living Mage at full health, unable to proceed. The upgrade scroll seen at decision 320 (log line 971) remained behind an eternal-fire safety buffer. Intuition identified a carried potion as frost at decisions 549–552 (lines 1656–1663), but decision 553 resumed exploration instead of its unfinished fire-observation return. The known-potion branch skipped that return, and the extinguisher only supported nearby throwing positions. At decision 596 (lines 1790–1791), mandatory pickup correctly prevented descent. Offline reconstruction on the played source matched all 596 selected action/reason pairs and reproduced the terminal failure. Copied-state probes established an existing guarded observation route, not fire clearance. The proposed correction preserves that bounded return after identification, prioritizes the existing local extinguisher, and retains hazard checks and mandatory collection. The new regression failed with the expected missing-action assertion on original source and passed on the candidate; the full suite passed 1,916 tests with four skips. Candidate reconstruction stopped at its first changed decision, 553; no changed gameplay was executed. This establishes preparation selection, not puzzle success or scroll collection.
